problem: Consider the countries that received a rating of “very high” in the 2023 Global Peace Index. Exclude any countries that have an area of either over 1,000,000 km2 or under 25,000 km2. Of the remaining countries, which had the highest CO2 emissions per capita in 2023 according to data.worldbank.org?
